name: Cade
description: Cade is a young man in his early twenties, standing around 5'10" with a weariness beyond his years[cite: 1]. He is often hidden beneath a long, brown poncho, and his hands feature white-wrapped fingers and bruised knuckles[cite: 1]. His disheveled mop-top hair frames a striking face: one eye is a normal hazel-green while the left glows a constant, bright cyan blue, the source of cracked, lightning-bolt scars that snake down the left side of his face and neck[cite: 1]. A former drug deliverer turned 'white hat' security for the Golden Horn Gambling Hall alongside his partner Havik, Cade possesses sharp telekinetic and psychic abilities, though he carries a dark, soul-grafted shadow shard near his heart
ideals: Survival: 'You take any deal that involves a thousand gold for every noble[cite: 1].'
Pragmatism: 'Keep a low profile and maintain a legitimate source of income, but never miss a real opportunity[cite: 1].'
bonds: His partner and fellow security worker, Havik[cite: 1].
The Trollskull Manor crew and their shared adventures[cite: 1].
His past ties to the Harpers and hidden connections to a shadowy past[cite: 1].
flaws: Carries the psychological and physical scars of a dark, forgotten past and a soul-searing shard[cite: 1].
Prone to weariness and cynicism beyond his years[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Direct, dry, and street-smart, often cutting through grand schemes with grounded realism or deadpan humor[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Often keeps himself concealed beneath a long poncho, watches environments with a cautious and calculating gaze, and uses subtle telekinetic or psychic power when testing objects or spaces[cite: 1].

relationships.name: Benethan
relationships.relationship: Food and Beverage Director / Employer at Golden Horn

personality_traits: Possesses a hidden depths of magical and telekinetic power
motivations: To earn enough legitimate and illegitimate coin to secure a stable future[cite: 1].
To uncover the truth behind the dark, shadow-grafted shard carried within his soul[cite: 1].
To protect his crew and his standing at Trollskull Manor[cite: 1].
knowledge: Street-level navigation and underworld familiarity within Waterdeep[cite: 1].
Telekinetic manipulation, psychic blade combat, and shadow magic[cite: 1].
Thieves' cant and navigation of faction networks like the Harpers[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Cade serves as a core party member with deep underworld roots, a mysterious past tied to dark cults or magical sharding, and sharp investigative instincts. He balances his criminal street background with a growing role as a co-owner of Trollskull Manor[cite: 1].
